seo.title: FAQ | ABailey Events
seo.description: Answers about wedding planning, booking, custom quotes and décor rentals — delivery, pickup, setup, rental periods and deposits — across Simcoe Muskoka.

title: Good to know
intro: A few answers to the questions we hear most. Don't see yours? Just ask — we're always happy to help.

items.a: We plan and coordinate weddings and events throughout Simcoe Muskoka.

items.q: What types of events do you plan?
items.a: Weddings are our specialty, and we also plan bridal showers, birthdays and corporate events. Our Bloom Bar is a beautiful addition to celebrations of every kind.

Our Bloom Bar is an interactive fresh-flower bar where your guests build their own bouquets to take home. We bring the flowers, the styled bar and a wrapping station, and help each guest put together a bouquet they'll love.

items.q: What's the difference between Month-of Coordination and Full Planning?
items.a: Month-of Coordination is for couples who have planned their wedding and want a professional to take over in the final month and on the day itself. Full Planning supports you from your very first consultation through to the last dance, including venue research, vendor booking, décor and design planning, and full wedding day coordination.

items.q: How much do your wedding packages cost?
items.a: Month-of Wedding Coordination starts at $800 and Full Wedding Planning starts at $1,500. Bloom Bar services are custom quoted, and the Elegant & Timeless Rental Package is $400 with setup included.
Yes. Every celebration is different, so we're happy to put together a custom quote for your event.

items.q: Are you a certified wedding planner?
items.a: Yes. Ayla, the planner behind ABailey Events, is WPIC certified.
Send us a consultation request through our contact page, email us, or message us on Instagram — whichever is easiest for you.
Yes, we deliver throughout Simcoe Muskoka. A delivery fee applies and is based on your event location.

items.q: Can I pick up rentals myself?
Do you offer setup and teardown?
items.a: Yes, we offer both. With the Elegant & Timeless Rental Package, setup is included and takedown is available for an additional fee.

items.q: How long is the rental period?
items.a: Our typical rental period is 2 days.
Yes, a security deposit is required on rentals. All rental terms are outlined in your rental contract.
